description: Header file defining GStreamer protection metadata structures and functions for Rialto EME protection integration.

classes.name: GstRialtoProtectionMetadata
classes.description: Structure representing Rialto protection metadata, extending GstMeta with an info field.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_get_type
methods.description: Returns the GType for the Rialto protection metadata.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Returns meta information about the Rialto protection metadata.

methods.name: rialto_mse_add_protection_metadata
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a GstBuffer with specified info.
